title: Rav Chananel bar Papa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 88b: He said, “What does the verse ‘Hear, for I will speak of princely things’ mean? Why are the words of Torah likened to a prince? To tell you that, just as a prince has the power to put to death and to give life, so too the words of Torah,” etc. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chanana bar Papa.
